Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting the custom blending of dry fertilizer from business and occupation tax.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting the custom blending of dry fertilizerfrom business and occupation tax; amending RCW 82.04.120; adding a newsection to chapter 82.04 RCW; creating new sections; providing aneffective date; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 82.04.120 and 2003 c 168 s 604 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) "To manufacture" embraces all activities of a commercial orindustrial nature wherein labor or skill is applied, by hand ormachinery, to materials so that as a result thereof a new, different oruseful substance or article of tangible personal property is producedfor sale or commercial or industrial use, and shall include: (((1)))(a) The production or fabrication of special made or custom madearticles; (((2))) (b) the production or fabrication of dentalappliances, devices, restorations, substitutes, or other dentallaboratory products by a dental laboratory or dental technician;(((3))) (c) cutting, delimbing, and measuring of felled, cut, or takentrees; and (((4))) (d) crushing and/or blending of rock, sand, stone,gravel, or ore. p. 1 SB 6485 (2) "To manufacture" shall not include: (a) Conditioning of seedfor use in planting; (b) cubing hay or alfalfa; (c) activities whichconsist of cutting, grading, or ice glazing seafood which has beencooked, frozen, or canned outside this state; (d) the growing,harvesting, or producing of agricultural products; (e) packing ofagricultural products, including sorting, washing, rinsing, grading,waxing, treating with fungicide, packaging, chilling, or placing incontrolled atmospheric storage; ((or)) (f) the production of computersoftware if the computer software is delivered from the seller to thepurchaser by means other than tangible storage media, including thedelivery by use of a tangible storage media where the tangible storagemedia is not physically transferred to the purchaser; or (g) the customblending of dry fertilizer.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) This chapter does not apply to the custom blending of dryfertilizer. The exemption provided by this section does not apply tothe sale of custom blended dry fertilizer. (2) As used in this section and RCW 82.04.120, "custom blending ofdry fertilizer" means blending dry fertilizer according tospecifications furnished by the customer prior to blending.
This act applies prospectively only and notretroactively.

This act does not affect any existing rightacquired or liability or obligation incurred under the section amendedin this act or under any rule or order adopted under those sections,nor does it affect any proceeding instituted under those sections.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectApril 1, 2006.
